title: Stack adapter configuration
description: How the stack-agnostic IR is rendered into implementation prompts. This describes OUTPUT, never measurement: the analysis core imports no stack adapter, and an audit invariant keeps it that way. Naming an adapter that is not implemented is recorded as `unsupported` rather than silently substituted, because a prompt written for the wrong stack is worse than no prompt.

status.description: `next-tailwind` is the only implemented adapter. Any other name is `unsupported` — recorded, refused, and never quietly replaced with the one that exists.

tokenSource.description: Where design tokens live in the generated code. CSS custom properties by default, so tokens survive a change of styling approach.

motion.description: Motion is emitted only where the evidence supports a motion claim. An unmeasured transition is never invented to fill the section.
